discription: A basic FM (Frequency Modulation) synth with ADSR envelope, allowing control over modulation ratio and index.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, modRatio=1.5, modIndex=0.5;    var carrier, modulator, env;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    modulator = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio) * (freq * modIndex);    carrier = SinOsc.ar(freq + modulator);    Out.ar(out, (carrier * amp * env) ! 2);} भूकंप
